proposals.rationale: Unstirred heating is a soft hypothesis for reduced solid-base and catalyst contact in this heterogeneous Buchwald-Hartwig amination.
Removing the reactor-to-heater connection tests the soft risk that sustained thermal activation at the specified heating step is necessary for productive coupling.
Replacing the BINAP addition with the existing palladium precursor creates a ligand-deficient catalyst system, a soft hypothesis for impaired catalytic turnover.
Replacing the cesium carbonate charge with the existing amine removes the inorganic base required for amine deprotonation, a soft hypothesis for diminished coupling efficiency.
